feeds.title: Invictus Law Blog
feeds.description: The Invictus Law Blog is a platform that provides expert insights on military law, security clearance, and veterans' affairs. The blog was founded by Mathew B. Tully, a retired U.S. Army Lieutenant Colonel and veteran of Operation Iraqi Freedom. His goal is to provide valuable information and resources to military personnel and veterans, helping them navigate complex legal issues related to their service.

feeds.title: Bond & Botes Law Offices Blog » Security Clearance
feeds.description: The Bond & Botes Law Offices Blog is a platform that offers expert insights on bankruptcy, debt relief, and security clearance. The blog was founded by Bradford Botes, an experienced bankruptcy attorney with over 30 years of experience. The blog's security clearance section is dedicated to helping individuals understand the security clearance process and navigate any issues that may arise.

feeds.title: Tully Rinckey PLLC » Security Clearance Representation
feeds.description: The blog was founded by Mathew B. Tully and Greg T. Rinckey, both of whom have extensive experience in military law and security clearance representation. Their goal is to provide valuable information and resources to individuals who need help navigating complex legal issues related to their employment or security clearance.

feeds.title: Berry and Berry, PLLC Blog
feeds.description: The BERRY & BERRY PLLC was founded by John and Kimberly Berry, both of whom have extensive experience in federal employment law. Their mission is to help federal employees and retirees understand their rights and benefits, and to provide them with the resources they need to make informed decisions about their future.
